This Windows image doesn’t have `sh`/`bash`, so I can’t execute `compile.sh` here, but the script itself is plain POSIX and just writes Python source.

The Python entrypoint compiles and runs, so I’m moving on to byte-for-byte comparisons with the official `.exe`.

"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "python -m py_compile .\\xsv_port.py .\\executable
@'
import subprocess, pathlib, sys, tempfile, os, json, difflib
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
ref=pathlib.Path(root/'REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()
py=[sys.executable, str(root/'executable')]

def run(cmd, cwd):
    return subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)

def case(name, files, args):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        d=pathlib.Path(d)
        for fn, txt in files.items():
            (d/fn).write_text(txt, encoding='utf-8', newline='')
        r=run([ref]+args,d); p=run(py+args,d)
        ok=(r.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr)==(p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr) and r.stdout==p.stdout and r.stderr==p.stderr
        ok = r.returncode==p.returncode and r.stdout==p.stdout and r.stderr==p.stderr
        if not ok:
            print('FAIL', name, args)
            print('ref code', r.returncode, 'py', p.returncode)
            print('ref out', repr(r.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')))
            print('py  out', repr(p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')))
            print('ref err', repr(r.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')))
            print('py  err', repr(p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')))
            return False
        print('ok', name)
        return True

cases=[
('headers', {'in.csv':'h1,h2\\na,b\\n'}, ['headers','in.csv']),
('count', {'in.csv':'h1,h2\\na,b\\n'}, ['count','in.csv']),
('select', {'data.csv':'h1,h2,h[]3,h4,h1\\na,b,c,d,e\\n'}, ['select','h1[1]-h1[0]','data.csv']),
('slice', {'in.csv':'header\\na\\nb\\nc\\nd\\ne\\n'}, ['slice','--start','1','--end','3','in.csv']),
('search', {'data.csv':'h1,h2\\nfoobar,barfoo\\na,b\\nbarfoo,foobar\\n'}, ['search','"'^foo'"','data.csv']),
('sortN', {'in.csv':'N,S\\n10,a\\nLETTER,b\\n2,c\\n1,d\\n'}, ['sort','-N','in.csv']),
('table', {'in.csv':'h1,h2,h3\\nabcdefg,a,a\\na,abc,z\\n'}, ['table','in.csv']),
('fmt', {'in.csv':'h1,h2\\nabcdef,ghijkl\\nmnopqr,stuvwx\\n'}, ['fmt','--out-delimiter','h','in.csv']),
('freq', {'in.csv':'h1,h2\\na,z\\na,y\\na,y\\nb,z\\n,z\\n(NULL),x\\n'}, ['frequency','--limit','0','--select','h1','in.csv']),
('stats', {'in.csv':'header\\n1\\n2\\n3\\n'}, ['stats','--median','--mode','--cardinality','in.csv']),
]
ok=True
for c in cases: ok=case(*c) and ok
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
'@ | python -"
